QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: Other Investment Products_27

question.text: Per the current National Savings Institute notification for the National Savings Time Deposit Account Scheme (verified 2026-05-15), what is the minimum deposit amount for a Post Office Time Deposit account?

answer.text: Rs.1,000, and thereafter in multiples of Rs.100

explanation.text: The Logic: The current National Savings Institute page for the National Savings Time Deposit Account Scheme states a minimum deposit of Rs.1,000 and thereafter in multiples of Rs.100, with no upper limit. The NISM XVII workbook (pp.171, 183) still cites the older Rs.200 minimum and is stale on this point. The Trap: Rs.200 is the legacy workbook figure and the most common distractor. Rs.100 is the NSC minimum; Rs.500 is the PPF annual minimum. Cross-Exam Context: NISM XVII tests Post Office deposit features; for any currentness-sensitive minimum, the National Savings Institute page is authoritative.
